name: External Unable To Apply Incorrect Data 1 Code
definition: Specifies the reason of an unable to apply due to incorrect data, as published in an external unable to apply incorrect data code set.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

IN02.name: Incorrect Payment Service Level
IN02.definition: Payment type service level is incorrect (former IncorrectBankOperationCode).

IN03.name: Incorrect Category Purpose
IN03.definition: Payment type category purpose is incorrect (former IncorrectInstructionCode).

IN05.name: Incorrect Interbank Settlement Date
IN05.definition: Interbank settlement date is incorrect (former IncorrectValueDate).

IN06.name: Incorrect Interbank Settlement Amount
IN06.definition: Interbank settlement amount is incorrect (former IncorrectSettledAmount).

IN11.name: Incorrect Payment Clearing Channel
IN11.definition: Payment type clearing channel is incorrect (former PaymentScheme).

IN18.name: Incorrect Instruction For Next Agent
IN18.definition: Instruction for next agent is incorrect (former IncorrectSenderToReceiverInformation).

IN19.name: Incorrect Instruction For Creditor Agent
IN19.definition: Instruction for creditor agent is incorrect (former IncorrectInstructionForFinalAgent).

IN33.name: Incorrect Report Entry Amount
IN33.definition: Amount in statement entry is incorrect.

MM20.name: Mismatch Creditor Name Account
MM20.definition: Name and account of creditor are not matching.

MM21.name: Mismatch Debtor Name Account
MM21.definition: Name and account of debtor are not matching.

MM22.name: Mismatch Creditor Agent Name Account
MM22.definition: Name and account of creditor agent (former FinalAgent) are not matching.

MM23.name: Insufficient Debtor Details
MM23.definition: Insufficient or incoherent details about the debtor with respect to regulatory requirements.

MM24.name: Insufficient Creditor Details
MM24.definition: Insufficient or incoherent details about the creditor with respect to regulatory requirements.

MM25.name: Pending Execution Debtor Account Or Identification
MM25.definition: Payment is pending execution. For reasons of regulatory requirements we request further information on the account number or unique identification of the debtor.

MM26.name: Pending Execution Debtor Name Or Address
MM26.definition: Payment is pending execution. For reasons of regulatory requirements we request further information on the name and/or address of the debtor.

MM27.name: Payment Executed Debtor Account Or Identification
MM27.definition: Payment has been executed. For reasons of regulatory requirements we request further information on the account number or unique identification of the debtor.

MM28.name: Payment Executed Debtor Name Or Address
MM28.definition: Payment has been executed. For reasons of regulatory requirements we request further information on the name and/or address of the debtor.

MM29.name: Pending Execution Creditor Account Or Identification
MM29.definition: Payment is pending execution. For reasons of regulatory requirements we request further information on the account number or unique identification of the creditor.

MM30.name: Pending Execution Creditor Name Or Address
MM30.definition: Payment is pending execution. For reasons of regulatory requirements we request further information on the name and/or address of the creditor.

MM31.name: Payment Executed Creditor Account Or Identification
MM31.definition: Payment has been executed. For reasons of regulatory requirements we request further information on the account number or unique identification of the creditor.

MM32.name: Payment Executed Creditor Name Or Address
MM32.definition: Payment has been executed. For reasons of regulatory requirements we request further information on the name and/or address of the creditor.

MM35.name: Insufficient Payment Purpose
MM35.definition: Payment purpose needs to be further specified.

NARR.name: Narrative
NARR.definition: See narrative field for additional information.
